slides.title: CHALLENGE ROOMS COMPLETED
slides.text: Having mastered the Mars Sandbox, Resource Control Bay with Bahaa & Mora, and Vertical Farming Station with Hamdy & Alaa, Commander Rodaina summons you to Johnson Space Center as Co-Commander.

slides.title: CLEANROOM PAYLOAD MANIFEST
slides.text: Launch mass is strictly constrained. Every kilogram of life support, water recycler, solar array, and scientific tooling competes for cargo capacity before the transfer vehicle can depart Earth.

slides.title: VOYAGE TO CHRYSE PLANITIA
slides.text: The transfer vehicle ignites its engines for the 180-day crossing to Mars. Telemetry locks onto the historic 1976 Viking 1 Lander beacon at Chryse Planitia to calibrate our descent corridor.
